title: Image descriptions become backend-choosable, and grow past captioning

summary: Created on Fabio explicit ask, member of the MPI-677 umbrella. Owns the Descriptions dropdown. Exists as its own card because imageDescribe has no DeepInfra/Ollama path at all - MODEL_REGISTRY is six text-only models - so it cannot share MPI-728 enhancement dropdown.

Fabio 2026-09-12, reviewing MPI-728: the goal in his words is to use a DeepInfra vision model for image descriptions so ComfyUI does not have to - confirmed as this card, scope items 1-2, no new card. PREMISE CORRECTION to the description: "every MODEL_REGISTRY model is text-only" is true of the app plumbing (no engine passes an image) but not of the models - DeepInfra tags google/gemma-3-12b-it and google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, both registry cloud ids, as vlm/vision in GET /v1/openai/models (checked 2026-09-12). Scope item 1 may therefore need an image-passing path rather than a new registry entry. NOT verified with a real image call. The registry is now four models: MPI-728 removed DeepSeek V3.2 and Qwen 3.6 35B.

Fabio 2026-09-15 (MPI-774 brainstorm): the Image descriptions job IS the in-app agent's eyes. MPI-774's orchestrator (text-only DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731) calls look(image, question, crop?) -> imageDescribe on the backend picked in this dropdown and never sees an image itself. Beyond scope 1-2 the agent needs: a question in place of the fixed caption instruction (image_descriptor.json node 38), an optional crop, and a box answer (Head Swap). Spec: tasks/MPI-774/brief.md § Depends on MPI-737. No change to this card's column or scope ownership.
